text: “不！”西尔维娅嘶哑地说。她的脸扭曲成久远记忆中那个女孩的模样——当年她曾在密斯卡托尼克大学的辅导课上分析一篇艰深论文。但她的声音却属于恶魔。“别靠近我。它在我体内，我会把它传给你。快跑！我……渴望……”
你看向诺曼，惊讶地发现他已惊恐地盲目逃跑。若你迟疑，可能再也追不上他。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 305
text: “No!” Sylvia rasps. Her face is the misshapen echo of a girl from long ago, analyzing a thorny paper in a Miskatonic tutorial room. But her voice is that of a demon. “Come no closer. It is in me and I will take you. Run! I… crave...”
You glance at Norman. To your surprise, he speeds away in blind terror. If you hesitate, you may never find him again.
